request.query: For every multivariate polynomial, its zeroth Hasse derivative is itself.

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_zero'
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (f : Polynomial R), (Polynomial.hasseDeriv 0) f = f

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_zero
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R], Polynomial.hasseDeriv 0 = LinearMap.id

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : Semiring R] → ℕ → Polynomial R →ₗ[R] Polynomial R

items.name: LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv_zero
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] {V : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module R V],
  LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R 0 = LinearMap.id

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_apply
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k : ℕ) (f : Polynomial R),
  (Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) f = f.sum fun i r => (Polynomial.monomial (i - k)) (↑(i.choose k) * r)

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_eq_zero_of_lt_natDegree
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ), p.natDegree < n → (Polynomial.hasseDeriv n) p = 0

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_one
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R], Polynomial.hasseDeriv 1 = Polynomial.derivative

items.name: LaurentSeries.derivative_apply
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] {V : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module R V]
  (f : LaurentSeries V), (LaurentSeries.derivative R) f = (LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R 1) f
